name: dia-text-reveal
title: Dia Text Reveal
description: A colourful gradient band that sweeps across text to reveal it, inspired by the Dia browser.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the text span (typography utilities).

props.name: text
props.description: Text to reveal. Pass several strings to rotate through them when `repeat` is on.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours sampled across the moving gradient band.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Colour of the text once revealed (follows your theme by default).

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait before the sweep starts.

props.name: repeat
props.description: Replay the sweep, advancing to the next string after each pass.

props.name: repeatDelay
props.description: Seconds to pause between cycles when `repeat` is on.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Start the sweep when the element scrolls into view.

props.name: once
props.description: Only play the first time the element comes into view.

props.name: fixedWidth
props.description: With several strings, reserve the widest string's width instead of animating the width.
